message.subject: Protective film gap for GSG post-Grimco
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I know GSG just completed the Grimco acquisition—congrats on that milestone. As you're evaluating your supplier portfolio across the combined network, I wanted to flag a gap I'm seeing in the market.

Your sign and graphics customers are increasingly asking distributors for graffiti-resistant overlaminates for transit, architectural, and public signage work. Most distributors don't carry anything that actually works—spray paint and markers still damage the graphics underneath.

We make a protective film where graffiti wipes clean without solvents or replacement. It's filling that exact portfolio gap for a few other distributors.

Would a quick 15-minute call make sense to explore whether this fits your priorities post-acquisition? Happy to keep it brief.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: The Grimco acquisition just closed in January 2025, placing procurement in active supplier consolidation mode
